cause.what: brain.py:33 computes lift = max(z0, z1) - self.clearance, subtracting the planner clearance loaded at brain.py:26 from brain.toml:2 clearance = 0.08 instead of raising the travel height above the endpoints.

evidence.shows: K4 t=2.035 frame 61 gap=1.0 px meets the mask-contact rule gap <= 2 px, while K3 t=1.935 frame 58 gap=17.0 px, K2 t=1.535 frame 46 gap=75.0 px, and K1 t=1.035 frame 31 gap=78.0 px show the blue arm monotonically closing on the green-masked red block before that contact.
evidence.value: K4 gap 1 px <= 2 px and K1 gap 78 px

evidence.shows: log t=1.300 has ee_xyz z=0.15297572498964448 at the end of the lift segment, and log t=1.500 has ee_xyz z=0.15282014366624638 with waypoint=2, so the arm traverses horizontally at about 0.153 m rather than above max(START,target); brain.py:34-35 define waypoint 1 as moving to (x0,lift) and waypoint 2 as moving horizontally to (x1,lift).

brain.py:26 reads cfg["planner"]["clearance"], brain.toml:2 sets clearance = 0.08, brain.py:33 uses that positive value as lift = max(z0, z1) - self.clearance, and brain.py:34-35 then send the arm across at that lowered lift height.

explanation: With START z=0.22 m at brain.py:10 and log t=0.000 ee_xyz z=0.22000000000000003, max(z0,z1) - 0.08 necessarily plans a low travel height around or below the start height; the observed log t=1.300 z=0.15297572498964448 and continued log t=1.500 waypoint=2 z=0.15282014366624638 match a planned low traverse, and K4 t=2.035 gap=1.0 px shows that this low traverse reaches the red block before the later descent waypoint in brain.py:34-35.
fix_direction: Change the direction of the clearance application in Brain.waypoint so lift is above max(z0, z1) by the clearance from brain.toml:2, keeping the same green target endpoint in brain.py:34-35 so the arm first clears the red block and only then descends to the target.
observed: K1 t=1.035 gap=78.0 px, K2 t=1.535 gap=75.0 px, K3 t=1.935 gap=17.0 px, and K4 t=2.035 gap=1.0 px show approach to mask contact, while log t=1.500 shows waypoint=2 ee_xyz z=0.15282014366624638 during the horizontal traverse.

plain.camera: The side camera shows the blue arm getting closer to the green block until it almost touches it.
plain.robot: The robot arm slides sideways very low instead of lifting up and over.
plain.why: That happened because the planner took the safety height away instead of adding it.

ruled_out.because: brain.toml:2 clearance = 0.08 is positive and brain.py:26 loads it, so the value is present; the failure is the subtraction sign at brain.py:33.
ruled_out.cause: Clearance config value missing, zero, or negative in brain.toml

ruled_out.because: log t=1.300 ee_xyz z=0.15297572498964448 and log t=1.500 waypoint=2 ee_xyz z=0.15282014366624638 stay at the planned low lift through the horizontal segment defined by brain.py:34-35, rather than showing a transient sag only near K4 t=2.035 gap=1.0 px; brain.py:45 PD follows targets from waypoint().
ruled_out.cause: PD tracking failure or gains kp/kd at brain.toml:5-6 causing sag into the block

ruled_out.because: log t=0.000 reaches ee_xyz [-0.09999999999999984, 0.0, 0.22000000000000003] matching START at brain.py:10, no unreachable-waypoint error from brain.py:16-17 is shown, and K1 t=1.035 gap=78.0 px to K4 t=2.035 gap=1.0 px show smooth approach rather than an elbow flip.
ruled_out.cause: Inverse kinematics sign/elbow error at brain.py:13-20

ruled_out.because: Spoken timing and K4 t=2.035 first contact align with waypoint=2 in log t=1.500 and log t=2.000, before the descent segment at brain.py:35 from (x1,lift) to (x1,z1), so the target descent itself is not the first failing segment.
ruled_out.cause: Final descent to the green target at brain.py:35
